name: Satvik Gupta
title: Software Developer

points: Built platform, control-plane, and application components for Salesforce Workspaces, used by 5,000+ engineers.
Developed the next-generation Kubernetes platform for Workspaces using Kubebuilder, improving reliability and disaster recovery.
Built an OpenTelemetry-based disk monitoring system, reducing disk-space support issues by 80%. Made an open source contribution to the gdu project
Reduced Workspace provisioning time from 18 minutes to 7 minutes (61% improvement)
Migrated manually provisioned resources to Terraform to provision complete dataplane infrastructure, including networking, IAM, DNS, and storage resources.
Agentic enablements - enabled Cursor for 3000+ developers, via secure SSH access to Workspaces via opkssh. Created a CLI and Claude plugin to enable agentic workflows for Workspaces.
Scoped and architected an LLM-powered support assistant for Workspaces, mentoring an intern through implementation.
Designed and developed a notification system for Salesforce Workspaces.
Enabled terminal-triggered alerts using Go CLI, Spring Boot and Slack SDK
Prototyped reliable scheduling with Temporal workflows, ensuring that notifications are (eventually) sent even if the service is down or the server is restarted.
Advocated for, and implemented, a Flutter version upgrade from 1.x → 2.0, enabling null-safety and improved performance. (40% faster builds, 30% faster startup time).
Architected bilingual (Eng/Hindi) support with future-proof i18n across all major screens

projects.name: TEDxDTU
points: Led a team of four developers building the TEDxDTU website and Flutter application.
Designed the backend architecture, MongoDB schemas, Firebase Authentication integration, and core REST APIs.
Managed production infrastructure, migrating from EC2 to GCP under increasing traffic before later moving the website to Vercel.
Website served 8,000+ users in 20 days and handled the majority of ticket sales; the Flutter app was used by event staff for ticket scanning and attendee check-in

projects.name: DTU-DCE Fraternity Forum
points: Led a team of 3 to develop a mobile app for DTU-DCE Fraternity Forum using Flutter. Launched on iOS and Android.
Built a secure app with JWT auth + REST backend integration. Collaborated with the backend team to build an API spec.

projects.name: Lucid Static Site Engine & Personal Website

Built CI/CD pipelines and deployed to AWS using S3, CloudFront, and GitHub Actions.
